project_summary: Warehouse management system with RFID gate automation and SAP WM integration

components.name: Core WMS (Spring Boot)
components.description: Receiving, put-away, picking, and shipping workflows with bin-level inventory tracking.

components.name: RFID gate automation
components.description: Antenna event processing, duplicate read filtering, and automatic GR/GI posting triggers.

components.name: SAP WM integration layer
components.description: IDoc and BAPI interfaces for stock transfers, delivery confirmations, and master data sync.

components.name: Handheld scanner UI (Android)
components.description: Kotlin app for forklift operators with offline queue and voice-directed picking prompts.
